entities.summary: Sopiko Guramishvili (b. 1991, Tbilisi) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tbilisi and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
